title: Listen and Choose a Response — Shopping

questions.stem: Isn't this store closing early because of the holiday?

options.C: Yes, at five, so we'd better hurry.

questions.explanation: This confirms the time and draws a conclusion. The others repeat 'closed', 'holiday', and confuse 'closing' with 'close' (near).
